unresolved.question: Page legend (odd-page style) lists only ক কলকলাহ, শ শিষ, গ গুন্নাহ, ম মোটা, ২ ইখফা, ∧ আরবী সাকিন; ২ labelled ইখফা and digits ১/৩/৪/৬ use the default labels.
The ৬ printed beside each ringed-wedge looks enclosed in a ring at scan resolution; recorded as plain ৬ (enclosure none), as on other pages.

Band signs are offset slightly from their letters; where a sign fell between two clusters it was anchored by tajweed sense (e.g. ১ before رَ in لَصَالُوا anchored to the alif; ম/৪ over لَضَآلُّوْنَ anchored to ض and the madd alif in print order).
Waqf signs: ط over circles 15-19, 26, 28, 33 and over مِسْكٌ encoded ؕ; small لا over 20-23, 25, 27, 32, 34 encoded ۙ; ج over 24 encoded ۚ; صلے over 29-31 encoded ۖ.
Maddah written as U+0653 throughout (كَلَّاۤ, وَمَاۤ, الْاَرَاۤئِكِ, انْقَلَبُوْۤا, اِلٰۤى, قَالُوْۤا, هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ, لَضَاۤلُّوْنَ).
